verdict.rationale: Lever markets itself as an 'All-in-One' platform replacing fragmented spreadsheets/email (lever-docs-35), has an applications API (lever-docs-32) and AI interview transcripts/summaries tied to candidate records (lever-docs-26), suggesting some consolidation of candidate data. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a single unified candidate profile combining resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status together. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of a unified candidate record view, consent/GDPR status tracking within that profile, and email thread integration shown as part of the same record.
